methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are a global media and technology company with two primary businesses, Comcast Cable and NBCUniversal' (FY2015 10-K); 'Some of these products and services charge no fee or a lower fee than our traditional video packages for access to their content, which adversely affects demand for our video services, including for expanded digital video packages, premium networks, and our DVR and On Demand services'; 'Reduced viewing of our content through traditional linear television distribution outlets has caused and will likely continue to cause audience ratings declines for NBCUniversal’s linear television content'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; STREAMING is live (from 2015-08-04) and its consumer-behaviour risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Comcast

theme_watch.reason: Live: Comcast's own FY2015 10-K says 'Changes in consumer behavior driven by alternative methods for viewing content may adversely affect our businesses and challenge existing business models. Some of these products and services charge no fee or a lower fee than our traditional video packages for access to their content, which adversely affects demand for our video services, including for expanded digital video packages, premium networks, and our DVR and On Demand services.' At the same time it streams to its own video customers: 'We also have streaming services that provide customers with access to certain programming via On Demand, online and through our mobile apps and, depending on the customer’s level of service, may require an additional monthly fee'. The stock trades at 18.4x FY16E — near its own median. The theme registry dates the market's pricing of streaming to 2015-08-04 (Disney lowers cable-network outlook on ESPN subscriber losses; media stocks sell off), evidence that names Disney's networks, not Comcast. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (STREAMING) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing streaming substitution of Comcast's video customers or networks specifically.

classification.quality_note: 'We are a global media and technology company with two primary businesses, Comcast Cable and NBCUniversal' (FY2015 10-K); 'Some of these products and services charge no fee or a lower fee than our traditional video packages for access to their content, which adversely affects demand for our video services, including for expanded digital video packages, premium networks, and our DVR and On Demand services'; 'Reduced viewing of our content through traditional linear television distribution outlets has caused and will likely continue to cause audience ratings declines for NBCUniversal’s linear television content'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; STREAMING is live (from 2015-08-04) and its consumer-behaviour risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Comcast. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.43x; +22% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.29; conservative 2yr +14%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY06-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +11.1%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +20.6%/yr (FY06-FY15 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +25.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY06-FY15); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2016-03-04) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.43x (26.3% downside to Bear $44 / +60.7% upside to Bull $96) | Adj composite 1.88 vs market 2.17: gap -0.29 [MODESTLY OVERVALUED] | +23% above the EPP floor $49 (15x FY16E $3.25) | Conservative 2-yr case: +13.9% total (+7.0%/yr) | At 18.4x FY16E the 15% hurdle price $79 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; video subscribers -0.2% in Q4 2015, forward revenues +8.5% (no FY16 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2015 revenue growth); streaming is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
